announcements.title: Fall Menu Launch — Staff Training Oct 5-6
announcements.body: Our new fall menu launches Monday October 5! Mandatory tasting and training sessions are scheduled: Mon Oct 5 at 10am at Hudson Yards and Union Square, Tue Oct 6 at 10am at Chelsea, Midtown East, and Brooklyn Heights. New dishes include roasted beet salad, butternut squash risotto, pan-seared duck breast, and two new cocktails. All FOH staff must attend their location session. BOH, please review updated prep sheets from your kitchen lead.

announcements.title: Tip Reporting Reminder — IRS Compliance
announcements.body: Reminder to all tipped employees: federal law requires reporting all tip income, including cash tips. Please ensure your daily tip declarations in the POS are accurate. Management is required to submit monthly tip reports to payroll. If you have questions about tip reporting, speak with your location manager. Non-compliance can result in IRS penalties for employees and the company. Thank you for your diligence.

announcements.title: Private Event This Saturday at Hudson Yards — Oct 3
announcements.body: Hudson Yards is hosting a private buyout event Saturday October 3, 7pm-11pm. Full dining room reserved for 90 guests. All Hudson Yards staff will be in formal uniform. Diane is the event lead. Extra server position is posted as an open shift — please claim if available. Kitchen, expect elevated course service. No walk-ins during buyout window. Setup begins at 5pm.

announcements.title: Health Inspection Prep — Chelsea Week of Oct 5
announcements.body: NYC Health Department has notified us of a scheduled inspection at Chelsea during the week of October 5-11. Sofia and the Chelsea team: please conduct a full deep clean this weekend, audit all fridge and walk-in temps, verify all ServSafe and NYC Food Handler certs are current and posted, and confirm FIFO labeling is up to date. Any concerns, contact Sofia immediately. We want an A grade — let's make it happen.

announcements.title: Daylight Saving Time Ends Nov 1 — Schedule Impact
announcements.body: Daylight Saving Time ends Sunday November 2 at 2am. Clocks fall back one hour. This affects closing staff hours and any early Sunday morning shifts. Sling will not auto-adjust; managers will review and republish any impacted shifts the week of Oct 26. If you work a closing shift on Saturday Nov 1, please be aware your shift may appear one hour longer on your timesheet. Questions? See your location manager.
